findings.chapter: Front matter — List of Figures / List of Tables (vs Ch. 3)
findings.evidence: List of Figures (PDF p.9): "3.4 Dense vs MoE parameter allocation and KV cache behavior . . . 57". List of Tables (PDF p.11): "Table 3-3 Parameter, compute and KV accounting for two model scales: dense 70B (canonical 80L/8192H full-MHA geometry) vs MoE 8×7B class (~47B total, its own 32L/4096H GQA geometry) . . . 58", with the note "where a caption closes one page and the rows begin on a later one — Table 3-3 is that case in this edition — the folio follows the rows, not the caption." In the body, the Fig. 3.4 art and its caption "figure 3.4: Dense vs MoE parameter allocation and KV cache behavior." are on folio 56 (PDF p.80); the Table 3-3 caption closes folio 55 (PDF p.79); the table's header row "metric | dense 70B | MoE (8×7B class) | derivation" begins on folio 57 (PDF p.81). Body folio = PDF page − 24 (verified at Fig. 1.1/folio 10, Fig. 3.1/folio 41, Table 4-2 rows/folio 81, Part III title/folio 141).
findings.issue: Both front-matter folios for this one stretch are stale: Fig. 3.4 is listed at 57 but sits on folio 56, and Table 3-3 is listed at 58, which matches neither its caption folio (55) nor the folio where its rows begin (57) — the book's own stated rows-folio rule yields 57. The List-of-Tables note is also inaccurate: it names Table 3-3 as *the* caption-closes-a-page/rows-begin-later case, but Table 3-1 (caption folio 43, rows folio 44) and Table 4-2 (caption folio 80, rows folio 81) are the same situation. Every neighbouring entry checked (Tables 1-1, 2-1, 2-2, 3-1, 3-2, 4-1, 4-2, 5-1, 5-2, 6-1, 7-1 and Figs. 1.1–6.2) matches the body, so the error is localised but will send a reader to the wrong pages.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate the front-matter figure/table folios from the rebuilt PDF: Fig. 3.4 → p. 56, Table 3-3 → p. 57 (rows folio), and re-word the List-of-Tables note so it does not single out Table 3-3 as the unique caption/rows split.

findings.evidence: Table 3-2 derivation column: "total parameters (across 8 experts)... ~5.7B per expert × 8 = 45.6B + ~1.4B always-on... = 47B".
findings.issue: Inconsistent rounding convention in MoE parameter derivation. The text states 5.7B is a rounded figure (unrounded 5.6625B), but the table's arithmetic line sums the rounded values to reach exactly 47B. Using the unrounded inputs, the sum is 46.7B. This creates an internal contradiction where the book explicitly notes it sits about 0.3B above the published total yet shows no error term in the summary table.
findings.fix_instruction: Change Table 3-2 derivation line to: "~5.66B per expert x 8 + ~1.4B always-on ~ 46.7B (published total)"

findings.evidence:
Section 3.8: "The team’s standing decision from Chapter 2 is the dense 70B model..."
Table 3-3 Note: "No single column difference isolates the routing effect because weight residency (140 GB vs 94 GB) differs."
findings.issue: Narrative consistency flaw regarding Chapter 2 scope. Section 3.8 references a specific architectural decision made in Ch 2, while Ch 2 only introduces and benchmarks the model geometry itself without making definitive model choice recommendations.
findings.fix_instruction: Replace reference to Ch 2 with: "Standing architecture for the canonical scenario is dense 70B full-MHA."
